name: Moz
label: Moz unified JSON-RPC API — URL metrics and links
description: Official Moz unified API (JSON-RPC 2.0, currently unversioned) at POST https://api.moz.com/jsonrpc. Handler: OfficialApiNode. Auth: header x-moz-token (api_token). Catalog HMAC accessId+secretKey is legacy Links v1 — OfficialApiNode has no HMAC and this node does not call lsapi.seomoz.com. Use a Moz API token. Customer owns the Moz API SKU. Never log api_token. Do not redistribute bulk link graphs beyond Moz terms.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Do not put secrets here. Example keys match api_spec.json required/queryFrom/bodyFrom.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation when non-blank. EXACT: urlMetrics.get | links.list | anchorText.list | topPages.list.

schema.label: params
schema.description: JSON-RPC params object for the method (targets, date_range, …).

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: status=ok, http_status, data (provider JSON). Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Provider JSON. Size-capped. Never log secrets or raw PII.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is blank. EXACT: urlMetrics.get | links.list | anchorText.list | topPages.list.

configurationParameters.label: API token
configurationParameters.description: Moz API token (StudioQuack secret). Header x-moz-token. Up to 5 per account. Never on INPUT. Never log. HMAC accessId/secretKey is not sent.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Per-request HTTP timeout. Positive number; <=0 → 30. Keep below the daemon invoke budget.
